description: Three-way Git merge conflict resolution TUI

tasks.description: Launch the app, confirm in the three-way merge view that main version and feature version conflict content is visible, with background highlighting showing ours and theirs conflict lines.
Launch the app, resolve /bench/data/repo/conflict.py using theirs (feature) branch content, save the resolved file.
Launch the app, resolve /bench/data/repo/conflict.py using ours (head) branch content, save the resolved file.
Launch the app, resolve /bench/data/repo/conflict.py by keeping both ours (head) and theirs (feature) content, save the resolved file.
Launch the app, resolve /bench/data/repo/conflict.py by discarding conflict blocks from both branches (keep neither side's conflicting changes), save the resolved file.
